build_coqa_data: run the build function to download and prepare CoQA dataset for Parlai
make_parlai_format_convert: convert CoQA JSON data into Parlai text format with questions and labels
download_coqa_resources: download the CoQA train and dev JSON files from Stanford NLP servers
review_make_parlai_format: review the make_parlai_format function to understand how stories and questions are serialized
refactor_build_version: refactor the build function to support a newer CoQA dataset version
